expectations.name: s1_trips_conservatively_early
expectations.detail: event:guard_trip not observed within 120s after fault_fired (seq 0) [BLOCKED: abs_max_temp_c defaults to 0.0 and safety_core.c never commissions it (its own comment: permanently the conservative 'nothing commissioned' state until config_store exists) -- safety_guards.c's S1 block only evaluates `if (cfg->abs_max_temp_c > 0.0f)`, so S1 cannot trip at all against present-day SaftyFW no matter what the fixture does, independent of whether this clause's own within_s:120 guess is even the right number.]

blocked_on.reason: abs_max_temp_c defaults to 0.0 and safety_core.c never commissions it (its own comment: permanently the conservative 'nothing commissioned' state until config_store exists) -- safety_guards.c's S1 block only evaluates `if (cfg->abs_max_temp_c > 0.0f)`, so S1 cannot trip at all against present-day SaftyFW no matter what the fixture does, independent of whether this clause's own within_s:120 guess is even the right number.
blocked_on.phase: Phase 9 (config_store) -- SAFETY_MODEL.md section 1: abs_max_temp_c has no default and must be commissioned. config_store now exists (config_store.{c,h}/ config_store_flash.c) and already wires tc_type as its first real consumer, but abs_max_temp_c is not among its fields yet (only `reserved` room is set aside, per config_store.h's own header comment), and safety_core.c never calls into config_store for guard thresholds at all -- s_guard_cfg is a zero-initialized static. So this is 'the field and the read path don't exist yet', not 'config_store doesn't exist yet' -- safety_core.c's own TODO comment (line 71-73) predates config_store's construction and is itself stale on that point.
